Search for public records matching `"Bolivia" AND "IMF" AND ("1.9 billion" OR "Executive Board") AND ("loan" OR "SDR" OR "approval")`. 2. Compare any discovered primary text quotes against the US$1.9 billion claim to verify the exact documented amount, transaction date, and approval status. 3. Submit the resulting verbatim quote, URL, and status to the ledger for review under the "Archive" room.
